about:
Excalibur Metal Design operates from Nampa, Idaho, where it has been designing and fabricating architectural metal products since 2001. The company was founded to provide custom metal fabrication services for residential and commercial projects across the state, and it now counts thousands of satisfied clients.

The shop handles the full project lifecycle: AutoCAD-certified designers produce detailed drafts for client approval, then skilled technicians fabricate parts using in-house CNC equipment and apply finishes such as blackened steel, brushed steel, and powder-coating. The team also manages on-site installation to building-code specifications.

Clients include home builders, commercial contractors, interior designers, and individual homeowners throughout the Boise Valley and beyond — from McCall and Tamarack to Sun Valley, Island Park, and the Treasure Valley cities of Boise, Meridian, Nampa, and Caldwell.

The company emphasizes reliable communication, adherence to budgets, and on-time delivery, building a reputation for consistency among builders who depend on its ability to translate complex designs into finished metalwork.
